root.label: David Flores reports five misdemeanor arrests from 2001 to 2004

events.label: David Flores reports five misdemeanor arrests from 2001 to 2004

slots.name: jail stays
slots.sentence: The Houston Chronicle reported in 2017 that Flores had been in jail five times prior to running for the mayor of Pasadena.

slots.name: misdemeanor count
slots.sentence: "Starting from my junior year at Sam Rayburn High School, I got in trouble with the law and was in and out of jail for five misdemeanors from 2001 to 2004," Flores said in the report.
